key_insight: Metadata-Driven AI uses LLMs to generate reusable analysis programs from metadata, keeping actual data outside the model.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic site prospecting, this pattern enables analysis over live geospatial APIs while reducing repeated inference and limiting data exposure.
method: Send only metadata across a one-way inference boundary to the LLM.
Execute generated analysis programs next to the data.
Retain programs for reuse without repeating inference for the same analysis.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a cost model, metadata-transfer measurements on public datasets, a small locally hosted model benchmark, and three applications, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Generated programs require validation before execution; keeping data outside the LLM does not guarantee correct or secure analysis.
paper_title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
